CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION rc_history.immutable_identity()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$BEGIN
 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR NEW.exercise_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.exercise_id OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at OR (OLD.state<>'ACTIVE_ID' AND (NEW.state NOT IN ('ARCHIVED_ID','FORENSIC_ID') OR OLD.binding IS NOT NULL)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'IDENTITY_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='42501';END IF;RETURN NEW;END$function$
